set.body:
Goal: assemble parsed native records into trusted scientific artifacts without hiding loss or incompatibility.

Acceptance criteria:
- Output distinguishes raw session, recording blocks, monocular Recording, BinocularRecording, native events, ObservedTimeline, metadata, diagnostics, and import report.
- Frame, clock, rate, eye, coordinate, pupil, and configuration specifications are explicit and validated.
- Binocular alignment is preserved at the sample index; left/right projections require explicit caller choice.
- Unsupported HREF/RAW materialization fails with named operands rather than relabelling values as pixels.
- The report reconciles physical lines, typed records, unknown records, rejected records, samples, native events, messages, recording blocks, and excluded data.
- No lossy operation appears as field access; materialization returns typed failure and accumulated warnings.
- Integration tests cover multiple blocks, mixed valid/invalid records, simultaneous messages, and source-to-artifact provenance.
set.title: Materialize validated EyeLink sessions, recordings, and observed timelines
